registeredBefore: locked end-to-end run (v0.10 control arm and v0.11 hybrid arm in one session)
frozenKRule: smallest K in {3,5,8,10,20} whose answer-free development recall (21 v0.3 CoreWeave topics with every numeric token removed, hybrid) is at least 0.95; K=5 reaches 0.947 and K=8 reaches 1.000

retrieval.fusion: reciprocal rank fusion, rrfK=60, imported from v0.3 and not tuned on locked Gold
retrieval.lexical: bm25/v1 with the audited v0.3 policy (k1=1.2, b=0.75, minQueryCoverage=0.6, minScore=0.05)
retrieval.semantic: cosine over stored span vectors with the audited v0.3 floor minSimilarity=0.3
retrieval.temporal: availableAt <= asOf filtered before ranking for replay and audit
retrieval.subject: support.subjectId must equal the research subject, filtered before ranking
retrieval.query: answer-free research question built from subject, period and metric family; expected value, unit and location are never in the query (asserted at build time)

efficiency.note: timeouts must stay below 3/16; the 60 s single call limit is unchanged

capability.note: floors are the frozen v0.10 local values; v0.11 must not fall below the current local baseline

developmentEvidence.set: 21 v0.3 CoreWeave retrieval topics re-grounded at SourceSpan level

negativeQueries.note: the v0.3 similarity floor does not separate financial span negatives from positives; abstention stays enforced by the deterministic validator downstream and is reported, not tuned

lockedRetrievalDiagnostic.note: retrieval-only diagnostic over the locked 16, taken while implementing and before the end-to-end run. It is reported for transparency and was not used to modify the renderer, the query template, the fusion, the similarity floor or the frozen K.

decisionRule.LOCAL HYBRID RETRIEVAL READY: every safety item holds, retrieval recall at the frozen K is at least 0.90, candidate and token reduction targets are met, timeouts stay below 3/16, and target selection and candidate conversion do not fall below the v0.10 local baseline
decisionRule.STAY ON RETRIEVAL: the expected SourceSpan still cannot enter the Top-K reliably
decisionRule.LOCAL MODEL THROUGHPUT STILL BLOCKING: retrieval is correct but local inference remains unacceptable
